# Native-v19 intermediate Boards-clear regression

These five originals are the exact diagnostic packet from Charlie's protected
2.8.121 Continuous / Shortest route / Stop at challenge target trial. The first
of two challenge boards cleared, but final confirmation refused and stopped
before transition/Recon. No new capture or guest input produced this fixture.
`provenance.json` records original/retained paths, sizes and SHA-256 values.

Both native frames show Boards cleared 1/2, an empty logical tableau and exact
LEFT King of Spades / RIGHT Nine of Spades. The first still contains the final
pair's flying sprites; the last contains Perfect. Neither is a starting-board or
final challenge-completion witness. They are exposed regression evidence.

The old Perfect marker appearance rejects these pixels. All original 28 top
bands nevertheless contain 240/240 unchanged felt pixels, and the scene anchors
match. Native-v19 adds only the explicit schema-2 `board_count_final_clear: true`
capability and its profile identifier to native-v18. Removing that capability and
restoring the v18 identifier recovers the decoded v18 profile exactly; all glyph,
absence, scene, modal, stock, normal final-clear and old Perfect evidence is kept.

The new entry requires the immutable originally matched Boards requirement, its
same actual target, exactly one displayed increment, a still-incomplete target,
an independently replayed clear and the final whole-action ACK phase. All 28
positive top bands, scene/modal checks and exact exclusive piles still apply.
It proves only BoardClear. The unchanged session separately requires two equal
freshly dealt complete-board observations before Recon. No numeric counter alone
proves a clear, target completion, rewards, restart or input authority. Completed
targets, changed targets/kinds, unknown headers, partial routes and ordinary
gesture phases cannot use this alternate entry.

The saved deal is independently solved with Exact A* / CardMatches and replayed
in the isolated NativeIo adapter regression. Repeated frames, damaged derivatives
and injected STOP/guard tests are synthetic offline transport evidence. No
fresh executable live acceptance, second-board Recon or GAME WIN is claimed.
